title: Climate-horizon extension: frozen run manifest
linked_declaration: results/benchmark/holdout_declaration.md (29 Sep 2026) and its addenda of 2026-09-30

git.head: 98a386db92cdbf2bb546af511ac0a41dd169df88
git.note: the extension code is not committed; the SHA-256 hashes below identify it exactly

frozen.architecture: ClimateHorizonNB: case GCNGRU (identity adjacency, hidden 32, 2 layers) + HorizonLagEncoder (target-relative, history 26, max_delay 29, 6 bumps, softmax) + climate GRU 16; gated log-mean fusion; NB2 heads; case-based dispersion; 10,028 params
frozen.likelihood: NB2, log mu = log1p(y_origin) + clamp(delta, ±10); point forecast = NB median
frozen.loss: pooled masked NB NLL; climate group gets grad of L_climate = sum a_h w_h L_h / sum a_h w_h, all other parameters grad of L_equal = sum a_h L_h; global clip 1.0; one Adam step
frozen.early_stopping: unweighted validation NB NLL, patience 15, max 150 epochs, best-state restore; validation = the year before the test year
frozen.preprocessing: per-fold imputation + z-scoring fitted on training years only (fit_end = train_end)
frozen.features: v2 tensors; case channels 9; climate channels 7 instantaneous; rolling means excluded
frozen.origins: every origin with 37 weeks of history; targets per split by their own date

pilots.shuffle: whole 37x7 window from the same district, donor origin in pilot-training history, +-2 weeks of year, different calendar year; frozen-model inference

utility.aggregation: MAE per unit on matched cells; mean over seeds within block; mean over blocks equally; no smoothing across folds
utility.weights: q = 4 u / sum u; w = (1 - rho) + rho q, rho = 0.95; uniform if sum u = 0

frozen.metrics: MAE (primary), peak MAE (district p90 of history up to the benchmark fit_end), NB NLL, WIS/coverage from NB quantiles; per fold = mean over observed test cells; seed-mean estimand primary (mean of per-seed MAE), seed-ensemble secondary; headline = mean of 7 folds
frozen.primary_comparison: D_target_measured vs B_target_equal, headline MAE, each h = 1..4; paired t-test and Wilcoxon over the 7 headline folds; Holm across the 4 horizons; 4-week time-block bootstrap 95% CI (all districts jointly, 2000 resamples)

criteria.practical_improvement: D - B <= -0.30 MAE at h = 3 or 4 with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and bootstrap CI below 0
criteria.non_inferiority: h = 1, 2: upper bound of the bootstrap 95% CI of D - B <= +0.30 MAE
criteria.otherwise: report as no measurable difference (a valid finding)

frozen.secondary: alignment (A vs B, C vs D), controls E/F/G/H vs B, all exploratory; references on common cells: persistence, gru_v2_nb, nb_shared_v2, lgbm_v2 (read-only)
frozen.holdout_2026: B and D only, 5 seeds; point estimate + 4-week block bootstrap CI; wording per the 29 Sep declaration; not a blind test (see addendum)
frozen.chronos: outside comparator only; no teacher outputs, utilities or features; fine-tuned variants excluded from the course deliverable

estimate_minutes.total: about 1 hour, at most 1.5 hours on this GPU; roughly 2-3x on a Colab T4
